MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 64
   C. 16
   D. 65

2. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 144

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 21
   C. 17
   D. 15

4. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

5. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

6. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 24
   C. 11
   D. 5

7. Solve for x: x + 8 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 8
   C. 10
   D. 17

8. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 36
   C. 13
   D. 37

9. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 81

10. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

11. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 82

12. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 16
   C. 0
   D. 17

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

1. B — 64
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Product = first factor × second factor
2. Substitute values: Product = 8 × 8
3. Product = 64
Final Answer: 64
Mark reminder: method mark for multiplication; accuracy mark for answer

2. D — 144
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Area of square = side × side
2. Substitute values: Area = 12 × 12
3. Area = 144
Final Answer: 144 m²

Working:

2. Substitute values: c² = 9² + 12²

Final Answer: 15 cm
